{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:59.400

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:07.760

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:34.059

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:36.260
    | text      = Dialogue aside, Star Wars is well written.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:39.159
    | text      = Darth Vader's a villain with a relatable backstory because he's not real and is a character in
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:45.400

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:50:49.599

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:53.599

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:57.400

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:58.980

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:03.239
    | text      = are poorly written.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:04.760
    | text      = Alex is just making up this story, but he's a shitty writer, so the villains have no complexity,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:09.920
    | text      = they have no pathos.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:11.159
    | text      = Their motivations make no sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:13.260
    | text      = He wants to be the author of an epic tale of good versus evil, but he has no skill with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:17.739
    | text      = actors, so all the bad guys just become cartoons.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:26.719

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:56:37.480
